1.web: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
1.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,
1.bsb: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

1.web: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.kjv: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
1.bsb: To the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace and peace to you from God our Father.

1.web: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
1.kjv: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
1.bsb: We always thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, when we pray for you,

1.web: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which you have toward all the saints,
1.kjv: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,
1.bsb: because we have heard about your faith in Christ Jesus and your love for all the saints—

1.web: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News,
1.kjv: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
1.bsb: the faith and love proceeding from the hope stored up for you in heaven, of which you have already heard in the word of truth, the gospel

1.web: which has come to you; even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth;
1.kjv: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it , and knew the grace of God in truth:
1.bsb: that has come to you. All over the world this gospel is bearing fruit and growing, just as it has been doing among you since the day you heard it and truly understood the grace of God.

1.web: even as you learned of Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on our behalf,
1.kjv: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;
1.bsb: You learned it from Epaphras, our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful minister of Christ on our behalf,

1.web: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.
1.kjv: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
1.bsb: and who also informed us of your love in the Spirit.

1.web: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
1.kjv: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it , do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
1.bsb: For this reason, since the day we heard about you, we have not stopped praying for you and asking God to fill you with the knowledge of His will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

1.web: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
1.kjv: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
1.bsb: so that you may walk in a manner worthy of the Lord and may please Him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God,

1.web: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy;
1.kjv: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;
1.bsb: being strengthened with all power according to His glorious might so that you may have full endurance and patience, and joyfully

1.web: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light;
1.kjv: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
1.bsb: giving thanks to the Father, who has qualified you to share in the inheritance of the saints in the light.

1.web: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love;
1.kjv: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:
1.bsb: He has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of His beloved Son,

1.web: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins;
1.kjv: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:
1.bsb: in whom we have redemption, the forgiveness of sins.

1.web: who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
1.kjv: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
1.bsb: The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.

1.web: For by him all things were created, in the heavens and on the earth, things visible and things invisible, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers; all things have been created through him, and for him.
1.kjv: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
1.bsb: For in Him all things were created, things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or dominions or rulers or authorities. All things were created through Him and for Him.

1.web: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.
1.kjv: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
1.bsb: He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.

1.web: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
1.kjv: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
1.bsb: And He is the head of the body, the church; He is the beginning and firstborn from among the dead, so that in all things He may have preeminence.

1.web: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him;
1.kjv: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;
1.bsb: For God was pleased to have all His fullness dwell in Him,

1.web: and through him to reconcile all things to himself, by him, whether things on the earth, or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.
1.kjv: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say , whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.
1.bsb: and through Him to reconcile to Himself all things, whether things on earth or things in heaven, by making peace through the blood of His cross.

1.web: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,
1.kjv: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled
1.bsb: Once you were alienated from God and were hostile in your minds, engaging in evil deeds.

1.web: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,
1.kjv: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:
1.bsb: But now He has reconciled you by Christ’s physical body through death to present you holy, unblemished, and blameless in His presence—

1.web: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which is being proclaimed in all creation under heaven; of which I, Paul, was made a servant.
1.kjv: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
1.bsb: if indeed you continue in your faith, established and firm, not moved from the hope of the gospel you heard, which has been proclaimed to every creature under heaven, and of which I, Paul, have become a servant.

1.web: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly;
1.kjv: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the church:
1.bsb: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for you, and I fill up in my flesh what is lacking in regard to Christ’s afflictions for the sake of His body, which is the church.

1.web: of which I was made a servant, according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you, to fulfill the word of God,
1.kjv: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;
1.bsb: I became its servant by the commission God gave me to fully proclaim to you the word of God,

1.web: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,
1.kjv: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:
1.bsb: the mystery that was hidden for ages and generations but is now revealed to His saints.

1.web: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory;
1.kjv: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
1.bsb: To them God has chosen to make known among the Gentiles the glorious riches of this mystery, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

1.web: whom we proclaim, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;
1.kjv: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:
1.bsb: We proclaim Him, admonishing and teaching everyone with all wisdom, so that we may present everyone perfect in Christ.

1.web: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
1.kjv: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.
1.bsb: To this end I also labor, striving with all His energy working powerfully within me.

2.web: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you, and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
2.kjv: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
2.bsb: For I want you to know how much I am struggling for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not met me face to face,

2.web: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,
2.kjv: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ;
2.bsb: that they may be encouraged in heart, knit together in love, and filled with the full riches of complete understanding, so that they may know the mystery of God, namely Christ,

2.web: in whom are all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge hidden.
2.kjv: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
2.bsb: in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

2.web: Now this I say that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.
2.kjv: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.
2.bsb: I say this so that no one will deceive you by smooth rhetoric.

2.web: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.
2.kjv: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.
2.bsb: For although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit, and I delight to see your orderly condition and firm faith in Christ.

2.web: As therefore you received Christ Jesus, the Lord, walk in him,
2.kjv: As ye have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk ye in him:
2.bsb: Therefore, just as you have received Christ Jesus as Lord, continue to walk in Him,

2.web: rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.
2.kjv: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as ye have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
2.bsb: rooted and built up in Him, established in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.

2.web: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elements of the world, and not after Christ.
2.kjv: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.
2.bsb: See to it that no one takes you captive through philosophy and empty deception, which are based on human tradition and the spiritual forces of the world rather than on Christ.

2.web: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,
2.kjv: For in him dwelleth all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
2.bsb: For in Christ all the fullness of the Deity dwells in bodily form.

2.web: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power;
2.kjv: And ye are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:
2.bsb: And you have been made complete in Christ, who is the head over every ruler and authority.

2.web: in whom you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ;
2.kjv: In whom also ye are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ:
2.bsb: In Him you were also circumcised, in the putting off of your sinful nature, with the circumcision performed by Christ and not by human hands.

2.web: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.
2.kjv: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who hath raised him from the dead.
2.bsb: And having been buried with Him in baptism, you were raised with Him through your faith in the power of God, who raised Him from the dead.

2.web: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,
2.kjv: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, hath he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
2.bsb: When you were dead in your trespasses and in the uncircumcision of your sinful nature, God made you alive with Christ. He forgave us all our trespasses,

2.web: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us; and he has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross;
2.kjv: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
2.bsb: having canceled the debt ascribed to us in the decrees that stood against us. He took it away, nailing it to the cross!

2.web: having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
2.kjv: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
2.bsb: And having disarmed the powers and authorities, He made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them by the cross.

2.web: Let no one therefore judge you in eating, or in drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,
2.kjv: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days :
2.bsb: Therefore let no one judge you by what you eat or drink, or with regard to a feast, a New Moon, or a Sabbath.

2.web: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.
2.kjv: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ.
2.bsb: These are a shadow of the things to come, but the body that casts it belongs to Christ.

2.web: Let no one rob you of your prize by a voluntary humility and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
2.kjv: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he hath not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
2.bsb: Do not let anyone who delights in false humility and the worship of angels disqualify you with speculation about what he has seen. Such a person is puffed up without basis by his unspiritual mind.

2.web: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.
2.kjv: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increaseth with the increase of God.
2.bsb: He has lost connection to the head, from whom the whole body, supported and knit together by its joints and ligaments, grows as God causes it to grow.

2.web: If you died with Christ from the elements of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,
2.kjv: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,
2.bsb: If you have died with Christ to the spiritual forces of the world, why, as though you still belonged to the world, do you submit to its regulations:

2.web: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”
2.kjv: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;
2.bsb: “Do not handle, do not taste, do not touch!”?

2.web: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?
2.kjv: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?
2.bsb: These will all perish with use, because they are based on human commands and teachings.

2.web: Which things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, and humility, and severity to the body; but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.
2.kjv: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.
2.bsb: Such restrictions indeed have an appearance of wisdom, with their self-prescribed worship, their false humility, and their harsh treatment of the body; but they are of no value against the indulgence of the flesh.

3.web: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
3.kjv: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
3.bsb: Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.

3.web: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
3.kjv: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
3.bsb: Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.

3.web: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
3.kjv: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
3.bsb: For you died, and your life is now hidden with Christ in God.

3.web: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.
3.kjv: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.
3.bsb: When Christ, who is your life, appears, then you also will appear with Him in glory.

3.web: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry;
3.kjv: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
3.bsb: Put to death, therefore, the components of your earthly nature: sexual immorality, impurity, lust, evil desires, and greed, which is idolatry.

3.web: for which things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
3.kjv: For which things’ sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:
3.bsb: Because of these, the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.

3.web: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them;
3.kjv: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.
3.bsb: When you lived among them, you also used to walk in these ways.

3.web: but now you also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.
3.kjv: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
3.bsb: But now you must put aside all such things as these: anger, rage, malice, slander, and filthy language from your lips.

3.web: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,
3.kjv: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;
3.bsb: Do not lie to one another, since you have taken off the old self with its practices,

3.web: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,
3.kjv: And have put on the new man , which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
3.bsb: and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.

3.web: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, freeman; but Christ is all, and in all.
3.kjv: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.
3.bsb: Here there is no Greek or Jew, circumcised or uncircumcised, barbarian, Scythian, slave, or free, but Christ is all and is in all.

3.web: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;
3.kjv: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
3.bsb: Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.

3.web: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
3.kjv: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
3.bsb: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

3.web: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
3.kjv: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
3.bsb: And over all these virtues put on love, which is the bond of perfect unity.

3.web: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful.
3.kjv: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
3.bsb: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, for to this you were called as members of one body. And be thankful.

3.web: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
3.kjv: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
3.bsb: Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God.

3.web: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.
3.kjv: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
3.bsb: And whatever you do, in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through Him.

3.web: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
3.kjv: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
3.bsb: Wives, submit to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

3.web: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.
3.kjv: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
3.bsb: Husbands, love your wives and do not be harsh with them.

3.web: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.
3.kjv: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
3.bsb: Children, obey your parents in everything, for this is pleasing to the Lord.

3.web: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.
3.kjv: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger , lest they be discouraged.
3.bsb: Fathers, do not provoke your children, so they will not become discouraged.

3.web: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.
3.kjv: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:
3.bsb: Slaves, obey your earthly masters in everything, not only to please them while they are watching, but with sincerity of heart and fear of the Lord.

3.web: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men,
3.kjv: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
3.bsb: Whatever you do, work at it with your whole being, for the Lord and not for men,

3.web: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
3.kjv: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
3.bsb: because you know that you will receive an inheritance from the Lord as your reward. It is the Lord Christ you are serving.

3.web: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
3.kjv: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
3.bsb: Whoever does wrong will be repaid for his wrong, and there is no favoritism.

4.web: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
4.kjv: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven.
4.bsb: Masters, supply your slaves with what is right and fair, since you know that you also have a Master in heaven.

4.web: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching therein with thanksgiving;
4.kjv: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
4.bsb: Devote yourselves to prayer, being watchful and thankful,

4.web: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds;
4.kjv: Withal praying also for us, that God would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds:
4.bsb: as you pray also for us, that God may open to us a door for the word, so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ, for which I am in chains.

4.web: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.
4.kjv: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
4.bsb: Pray that I may declare it clearly, as I should.

4.web: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
4.kjv: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
4.bsb: Act wisely toward outsiders, redeeming the time.

4.web: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
4.kjv: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
4.bsb: Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how to answer everyone.

4.web: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.
4.kjv: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you, who is a beloved brother, and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord:
4.bsb: Tychicus will tell you all the news about me. He is a beloved brother, a faithful minister, and a fellow servant in the Lord.

4.web: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,
4.kjv: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that he might know your estate, and comfort your hearts;
4.bsb: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know about us, and that he may encourage your hearts.

4.web: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.
4.kjv: With Onesimus, a faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They shall make known unto you all things which are done here.
4.bsb: With him I am sending Onesimus, our faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will tell you about everything here.

4.web: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received commandments, “if he comes to you, receive him”),
4.kjv: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you, and Marcus, sister’s son to Barnabas, (touching whom ye received commandments: if he come unto you, receive him;)
4.bsb: My fellow prisoner Aristarchus sends you greetings, as does Mark the cousin of Barnabas. You have already received instructions about him: If he comes to you, welcome him.

4.web: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.
4.kjv: And Jesus, which is called Justus, who are of the circumcision. These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God, which have been a comfort unto me.
4.bsb: Jesus, who is called Justus, also sends greetings. These are the only Jews among my fellow workers for the kingdom of God, and they have been a comfort to me.

4.web: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
4.kjv: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, saluteth you, always labouring fervently for you in prayers, that ye may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
4.bsb: Epaphras, who is one of you and a servant of Christ Jesus, sends you greetings. He is always wrestling in prayer for you, so that you may stand mature and fully assured in the full will of God.

4.web: For I testify about him, that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.
4.kjv: For I bear him record, that he hath a great zeal for you, and them that are in Laodicea, and them in Hierapolis.
4.bsb: For I testify about him that he goes to great pains for you and for those at Laodicea and Hierapolis.

4.web: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas greet you.
4.kjv: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas, greet you.
4.bsb: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas send you greetings.

4.web: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the assembly that is in his house.
4.kjv: Salute the brethren which are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the church which is in his house.
4.bsb: Greet the brothers in Laodicea, as well as Nympha and the church that meets at her house.

4.web: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans; and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.
4.kjv: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that ye likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.
4.bsb: After this letter has been read among you, make sure that it is also read in the church of the Laodiceans, and that you in turn read the letter from Laodicea.

4.web: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”
4.kjv: And say to Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfil it.
4.bsb: Tell Archippus: “See to it that you complete the ministry you have received in the Lord.”

4.web: The salutation of me, Paul, with my own hand: remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
4.kjv: The salutation by the hand of me Paul. Remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.
4.bsb: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul. Remember my chains. Grace be with you.
